name: AriaOS Kernel Work Modes & GPU Telemetry
description: Pre-trained system & kernel performance profiles (Gaming, Development, Creative Studio, Extreme Power Save, Security Fortress) and real-time GPU/DRM hardware telemetry.

tools.name: list_work_modes
tools.description: List all available AriaOS Kernel Work Modes (gaming, development, creative, powersave, security, balanced) and the currently active mode.

tools.name: apply_work_mode
tools.description: Activate a system-wide AriaOS Work Mode that tunes Linux kernel parameters (CPU governor, swappiness, RAM compaction) and optionally launches the mode's application suite.

launch_apps.description: Whether to automatically launch the mode's primary workspace applications.

tools.name: gpu_telemetry
tools.description: Read real-time GPU hardware telemetry across AMD, Intel, NVIDIA, and VM VirtIO/QXL adapters via /sys/class/drm and vendor SMI tools.
